title: DiversiGen: Evolutionary Fund Diversification Initiative
body:
Dear Edgeware Community,

Subject: Funding Request for Investment Opportunity and additional stream for the Contributors Support Program (CSP)

**[DiversiGen: Evolutionary Fund Diversification Initiative - Google Docs](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xO6dlDoXRVgZeloSQlAiwQqQR7e7zdX_hE2IGZUc3-Q/edit#heading=h.8ptq3dz9rx6s)**

**Introduction:**
Myself Ashutosh Sahu AKA ZEROM working as the Senior Community Moderator from 2021.
Contacts: [Telegram](http://t.me/ZeromVincent) / [Email ](mailto:ashutosh@edgeware.community)/ [Twitter](https://twitter.com/ZeRoMViNcENT)
Proposal Date: - 19-01-2023


I hope this letter finds you in good health and high spirits. I am writing today with a proposal for funding from the [Diversification Fund](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/13201-edg-diversification-fund-funds-recoup-proposal). As an aspiring investor and trader, I've been actively trading cryptocurrencies since 2017, experienced both bull and bear markets, which has given me a deep understanding of the crypto market's dynamics. As a successful trader, I'm seeking this funding to support CSP incentives and diversify our treasury.

**Proposal Summary:**

I am seeking funding in the amount of $3,000 USD for a one-year investment. The funds will be used for trading in the financial markets, specifically in the realm of investment, e.g., cryptocurrency trading & Investment.

**Investment Opportunity:**

With the investment opportunity I have identified has the potential to generate a consistent monthly return of 3-15%. I have conducted thorough research, developed a well-defined strategy, and had a track record of successful trading in this market.

**Use of Funds:**

The funds will be used exclusively for trading capital, risk management, and associated expenses over the course of the one-year. I am committed to employing a prudent approach to minimize risks and maximize returns.
